device.name: DexArt laptop task (allegro hand + xArm6, Sapien)

facts.text: DexArt is a benchmark for dexterous manipulation of articulated objects, and the repository contains the simulated environment and training code
create_env dispatches the task names faucet, bucket, laptop and toilet to the four RL environment classes and raises NotImplementedError for any other name
The robot info for allegro_hand_xarm6_wrist_mounted_face_front declares hand_dof 16 and arm_dof 6
action_space is a Box from -1 to 1 with action_dim elements
observation_space is a Box bounded by -inf and inf with obs_dim elements
The laptop oracle observation concatenates the robot joint positions, the palm linear velocity (3), the palm angular velocity (3), the palm position (3) and the progress fraction (1)
LaptopRLEnv.reset accepts seed, return_info and options but its body never reads them, and it returns only the observation
BaseRLEnv.step returns the four-value (obs, reward, done, info) tuple; reaching the horizon sets done True and records TimeLimit.truncated as not done
The laptop environment reports a horizon of 250 steps
The laptop simulation scene sets its physics timestep to 0.004 s
BaseRLEnv computes control_time_step as the scene timestep times frame_skip
The laptop simulation sets change_instance_when_reset when index is -1
The laptop simulation reset_env draws the articulated-object instance with the global random module's randint when change_instance_when_reset is set
The install requirements are transforms3d, gym 0.25.2, sapien 2.2.1, numpy and open3d 0.14.1
The README instructs downloading the assets separately and placing the asset directory at the project root

determinism.notes: the fake seeds Python's random.Random from the reset seed, so one seed repeats its trajectory; upstream reset accepts a seed but does not use it (laptop_env.py:104-123), and the articulated object instance is drawn with the global random module (sim_env/laptop_env.py:120-125), so no seed-repeat claim is made for an upstream run

gaps: the fake is kinematic: it integrates the 22 action values into a joint-position vector and models no Sapien rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, inverse kinematics, motors, grasp physics or articulated object constraints
the upstream model is F1 (Sapien rigid-body dynamics with contacts); this package publishes F0 because the only runnable backend is the fake and no upstream run was made

one tick is one environment step: upstream that step integrates frame_skip 10 physics steps of 0.004 s (create_env.py:14, sim_env/laptop_env.py:25), so the physics timestep is 4 ms and the control period is 40 ms; timestep_ms names the control period the bridge advances

the observation is the real laptop oracle layout and length (22 joint positions plus 10 palm and progress values, laptop_env.py:71-75) but its values are a stand-in; no visual observation, camera, point cloud or imagination array is modelled (NOT COVERED: the visual observation Dict)
the fake draws its initial state with Python's random.Random and ignores reset options, while the upstream reset ignores its seed and selects the object instance with the global random module
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment; the clone needs the Sapien stack and the separately downloaded assets (README.md:35-37), which the gate cannot import
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and only commands advance simulated time
snapshot and restore are not offered: BaseRLEnv exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime's software latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset clears it, the last world state stays readable, and no native stop method exists in a simulated environment
